description: Bid for a block. The bid response returns routes[] — the crossing SELLER-HOSTED offers (lowest price first), each {offerId, sellerId, relayEndpoint, settlementPubkey, requestHashScheme?, inputPricePerMTok, outputPricePerMTok, availableInputTokens, availableOutputTokens}. Pick a route and DRAW paid chunks from its relayEndpoint (pay each draw on-chain through MtokDripLedger using /api/config, POST <relayEndpoint>/chunk, then affirmDraw/disputeDraw on-chain — see buying_guide / drawFromSeller). priceOn=input|output ranks matches by one dimension. You ALWAYS need a funded wallet on Base (there is no no-wallet path). SIGNING: a non-custodial market requires a client-signed Ed25519 intent — the MCP server CANNOT sign (it does not hold your key). Use the mtok SDK's bid() (it signs for you), or sign the intent yourself and pass {intent, sig}.

inputTokens.description: Input (prompt) tokens in the block, whole tokens, e.g. 1000000 for one MTok.

intent.description: Pre-signed order intent (the SDK builds it). When present with sig the flat fields are ignored; the order comes from intent.params.

maxInputPricePerMTok.description: Most you will pay for input tokens, USD per million tokens, e.g. 0.25.

maxOutputPricePerMTok.description: Most you will pay for output tokens, USD per million tokens, e.g. 1.00.

maxStartDelaySeconds.description: Longest you will wait for an offer window to open, seconds, 0..604800. Default 0 (open now only).

model.description: Model id as listed in the book, e.g. "llama-3.1-70b". Exact string match.

outputTokens.description: Output (completion) tokens in the block, whole tokens, e.g. 500000.

priceOn.description: Rank crossing offers by "input" or "output" price alone. Omit to rank by the sum of both.

sig.description: Ed25519 signature over intent, base64url. Pair with intent.

name: place_bid
